basis: Neurodevelopmental impairment, seizures and structural brain abnormalities define disease; isolated extracerebral findings with tiny denominators do not establish ≥30% involvement.
Metabolic lipodystrophy destroys subcutaneous fat; hepatic steatosis reported in 1/1, consistent with ectopic lipid deposition. Pancreatitis and hypertension are separate diseases.
Inherited cardiac repolarization disorder causing prolonged QT and ventricular arrhythmias; syncope does not establish neurologic damage.
Deficient bronchial cartilage causes bronchomalacia and bronchiectasis; disease is confined principally to the airways.
Carcinoma originates in the lung or bronchial glands; no common direct involvement of another axis established.
Ovarian germ cell–sex cord neoplasm has reproductive origin. Hormonal abnormalities are inconsistent and do not establish a defining endocrine disorder.
Developmental skeletal asymmetry and cognitive impairment define the syndrome; congenital heart defects occur in roughly half or more. Pigmentary marks alone do not establish skin damage.
Calculi occupy the lower urinary tract; bladder and urethra belong to the renal axis.
DPPX antibody-mediated encephalitis; direct enteric neuronal dysfunction causes persistent diarrhea and intestinal dysfunction in approximately 50–80%.
An inherited mitochondrial metabolic disorder by ancestry; no specific phenotype establishes common direct damage to additional organs across this category.
